summary: Full regression + new SEO expansion (9 suburb pages + resource centre with 4 articles) verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. Frontend: all 9 suburb routes render with correct data-testid=suburb-{slug}, unique <title> containing suburb name, H1 'Builders & renovations in {Name}.', FAQPage JSON-LD with exactly 6 Question entries, and no forbidden Apollo-specific claims. Geographic keywords verified on Brighton (Bayside City Council + bathing boxes), Berwick (City of Casey + Old Cheese Factory), Clyde (Casey + Urban Growth Zone), Glen Waverley (City of Monash + The Glen — present in DOM via textContent; innerText upper-cases the eyebrow so a case-insensitive check is needed). Unknown suburb /suburbs/nonexistent correctly redirects to /. Resources index renders data-testid=resources-page with 4 article cards; each article page has correct data-testid=resource-{slug}, H1, Article JSON-LD, and multiple H2 sections. /resources/nonexistent redirects to /resources. Sitemap has 23 <url> entries with all suburb + resource URLs. Footer contains 9 suburb links (/suburbs/brighton…glen-waverley) + 1 /resources link. Meta tags remain 1 per tag (description, canonical, og:title). No regressions on Home, About, Services, Contact, /services/kitchen-renovations — all titles resolve via Helmet correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Suburb.jsx testid convention is 'suburb-{slug}' (e.g. suburb-brighton) — the review request text mentioned 'suburb-premium-apollo' which appears to be a spec typo; actual implementation is correct and per-slug.
Suburb faqSchema builds 6 questions (3 auto-generated suburb-specific + 3 from shared faqs). Working as intended.
Footer 'Areas We Service' block hard-codes the 9 suburb slugs. If suburbData grows this list must be updated in two places (Footer.jsx and seoContent.js). Consider deriving from suburbData.
Glen Waverley eyebrow uses CSS text-transform:uppercase; keyword scanners using .innerText will get 'CITY OF MONASH'. Use .textContent for content assertions.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (relaxed email_provider assertion to accept 'pending'|'stubbed'|'resend' since /api/health currently returns 'pending')
